# Snapchat

2 endpoints, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 2 standard (1 credit) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

<!-- BEGIN:GENERATED:TOC (auto-generated by generate-docs.ts - SK-02) -->

| Endpoint | Cost | Returns | Use when |
|----------|------|---------|----------|
| [GET /v1/snapchat/profile](#get-v1snapchatprofile---1-credit-standard) | 1 credit (standard) | Returns a Snapchat account's public profile: display name, Bitmoji avatar URL… | Use it to confirm a Snapchat account exists and read its public details. |
| [GET /v1/snapchat/spotlight/comments](#get-v1snapchatspotlightcomments---1-credit-standard) | 1 credit (standard) | Returns comments on a Snapchat Spotlight snap, each with text, display name, reaction… | Use it when you have a Spotlight URL and want the comment thread, paging with cursor. |

**Cheaper or broader options:** `prism/profiles` - Up to 50 profiles per call, at the same price per profile, with the ones not found refunded.

## GET /v1/snapchat/profile - 1 credit (standard)

Returns public profile information for a Snapchat user including display name, Bitmoji avatar URL, subscriber count, and bio description.

**Use when** you want to confirm a Snapchat account exists and read its public details.
**Cost** cache 900 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `handle` (required) - Snapchat username · e.g. `djkhaled305`

**Response** `Author` object at `data`, `{ author, computed }` ([full schema](schemas/Author.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `author.id` | Platform-specific user ID… |
| `author.url` | Direct URL to the profile page |
| `author.username` | User handle or username |
| `author.avatar_url` | URL to profile picture |
| `author.bio` | Profile biography or description |
| `author.display_name` | Display name or full name |

+10 more fields in the full schema. Never filled: `author.likes_count`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/snapchat/profile" \
  --data-urlencode "handle=djkhaled305" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/snapchat/spotlight/comments - 1 credit (standard)

Returns comments on a Snapchat Spotlight snap. Each comment includes text, display name, reaction count, nested reply count, and timestamp. Page with cursor.

**Use when** you have a Spotlight URL and want the comment thread, paging with cursor.
**Cost** cache 300 s
**Paging** cursor · ≈25/page (observed) · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/25) x 1 credits

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - Full URL of the Snapchat Spotlight snap. · e.g. `https://www.snapchat.com/@lilah4823/spotlight/W7_EDlXWTBiXAEEniNoMPwAAYY2pvZnd0ZXVmAZ8fgG8pAZ8ff-_IAAAAAQ`
- `cursor` (optional, string) - Cursor from the previous response to fetch the next page.

**Response** `CommentList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ comment, computed }` ([full schema](schemas/CommentList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `comment.text` | Comment body. |
| `comment.id` | Platform-specific comment ID (always a string) |
| `comment.published_at` | Comment creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string. |
| `comment.post_id` | ID of the post this comment belongs to |
| `comment.author.display_name` | Comment author display name |
| `comment.engagement.likes` | Like / upvote count |

+3 more fields in the full schema. Never filled: `comment.author.avatar_url`, `comment.author.username`, `comment.author.verified`, `comment.flags.pinned`, `comment.parent_id`, `comment.url`. Page-level: `data.comment_recency`, `data.dropped`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/snapchat/spotlight/comments" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://www.snapchat.com/@lilah4823/spotlight/W7_EDlXWTBiXAEEniNoMPwAAYY2pvZnd0ZXVmAZ8fgG8pAZ8ff-_IAAAAAQ" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
